steps.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: a rhythm-game release-note sprite.
Image 1 is the approved simplified release note to edit; image 2 is the matching hold-body material reference ONLY.
Change SHADING ONLY. Preserve image 1's exact 5:1 rectangular outline, central downward-tapering trapezoid/U face, all slopes, low U-shaped light rim, thin outer borders, proportions, saturated blue palette and overall brightness. Do not add geometry, seams, facets, hardware, ornaments or side light bars. The broad wings and central face should feel related to the hold body's clean cel-shaded planes.
Keep cel shadow steps modest and blue, never navy/gray. Avoid globally darkening it, metal grain, noisy texture, shiny 3D bevels, and white areas on the broad faces.
IMPORTANT: remove the chevron icon and leave the central face blank: exact approved vector icons will be re-added in the export. Preserve one small beam-ending light at exactly the center of the lower U rim. Any smooth gradient must be associated with light from that rim or hotspot, not an all-over airbrushed surface.
One full isolated sprite only, centered, transparent background with no outside glow; no labels, text, mockup or supporting body.
SHADING VARIANT: Use three broad, clean flat color values across the existing faces, with subtle but visible hard cel boundaries. Retain a moderately broad smooth light falloff around the lower U rim and central beam hotspot, covering roughly the lower quarter of the central face. Make the wing faces mostly flat, with one subdued broad cel shadow region. This is the gentlest shift from the approved artwork; cell boundaries must still be visible.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the blue cel-shading variant to convert into its gold DOUBLE counterpart. Image 2 is the approved gold release note, used ONLY for the gold palette, unchanged silhouette and beam positions. Image 3 is the gold hold-body material reference.
Preserve image 1's EXACT cel shadow shapes, flat paint areas and balance of local soft light to flat shading. Convert the saturated blue palette into the medium bright gold of image 2, consistent with image 3. Do not brighten the whole face to cream/white, darken it to bronze/brown, or introduce orange. Keep the same average brightness family as the approved gold release.
Keep the 5:1 rectangular outline, tapered central U face, original slopes and thin rim. No additional facets, hardware, bars or decorative seams. Keep the wings and broad center mostly flat as in image 1. Soft gradients only where light actually emanates from the lower rim.
Replace the one center beam hotspot with TWO small distinct spots at precisely 42% and 58% width on the lower U rim; no 50% hotspot. Leave the center completely BLANK, no arrows, text or icons; exact approved symbols will be composited later.
